observations.code_quote: If you work at PostHog and want a remote workspace instead of running the stack on your laptop, see the [internal Coder workspaces guide](https://github.com/PostHog/posthog/blob/master/docs/internal/coder-workspaces.md). We call a Coder workspace a devbox, and `hogli` manages it.
